question: Who inaugurated the Shri S Ramakrishnan Centre of Excellence at IIT Madras in 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**ISRO Chairman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Shri S Ramakrishnan Centre of Excellence** was inaugurated at **IIT Madras**, which is one of India's leading institutions in science and technology research.
 
• The center is named after **Shri S Ramakrishnan**, a renowned figure in the field of space and technology.
 
• The **ISRO Chairman** is a key figure in India's space research and development and represents the **Indian Space Research Organisation** (ISRO).
